meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes, so tell me who decided this and when.
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.

A machine's guess, and you entered a zero on it. The company's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student; I have it printed in my bag. Was Owen heard before that mark went in, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and confirmation that nothing about this is on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position; she agreed to nothing and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen kept clear of any record.
What moved her: Nothing, because she heard no ownership of the process and saw no document she could check.
What cost ground: Leading with the detector score as the only reason for the zero, because she distrusts software and came with the vendor's own warning against using it alone.
Try next time: In your first line, own that the zero was entered before anyone called home, which breaks the school's own procedure, then show her a dated piece of Owen's own work that she can read for herself.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
